```artifact
Feature: Admin Management

  Scenario: Add Lab
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab 1" and address "123 Main St"
    Then the lab is added successfully

  Scenario: Add Chemist
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist 1" and email "chemist1@example.com"
    Then the chemist is added successfully

  Scenario: Update Doctor Information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor with ID 1 exists
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Dr. Smith"
    Then the doctor's information is updated successfully

  Scenario: Add New Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality is added successfully

  Scenario: View and Update Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality with name "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin views the speciality details
    And the admin updates the speciality name to "Cardiology Updated"
    Then the speciality details are updated successfully

  Scenario: Delete Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality with name "Cardiology" exists
    And no doctors are attached to the speciality
    When the admin deletes the speciality
    Then the speciality is deleted successfully

  Scenario: Associate Doctor with Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor with ID 1 exists
    And the speciality with name "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin associates the doctor with the speciality
    Then the doctor is associated with the speciality successfully

  Scenario Outline: Add New Speciality with Unique Name
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    Then the speciality is added successfully

    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Neurology       |
      | Invalid Name    |

  Scenario Outline: View and Update Speciality with Invalid Name
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality with name "<speciality_name>" exists
    When the admin views the speciality details
    And the admin updates the speciality name to "<new_speciality_name>"
    Then the speciality details are updated successfully

    Examples:
      | speciality_name | new_speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      | Cardiology Updated  |
      | Invalid Name    | Valid Name          |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Speciality with Attached Doctors
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality with name "<speciality_name>" exists
    And the doctor with ID 1 is attached to the speciality
    When the admin deletes the speciality
    Then an error message is displayed indicating that the speciality cannot be deleted

    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Invalid Name    |
```
